plan.venue_summary: Mercury Lounge's crowd buys guitar-driven indie and post-punk, from Art Brut and Interpol to The Royston Club and Jejune. Its Lower Manhattan bookings mix established indie names with rising bands.

recommendations.why: Fans of The Royston Club, Jejune and Elephant Stone love Bodega, a very strong taste match for this room. They played Rough Trade Below on 15 Oct but haven't played Mercury Lounge recently.
recommendations.routing_note: Played Rough Trade Below (NYC) on 15 Oct and Millennium Film Workshop on 9 Oct; not Mercury Lounge.
recommendations.offer_email:
Subject: Bodega at Mercury Lounge

Hi there,

I'm the talent buyer at Mercury Lounge in New York. Bodega keeps coming up as a strong fit for our audience. Fans of The Royston Club and Jejune, who sell well for us, love them. We noticed your recent NYC shows and would love to bring you to our stage for a headline night.

We'd suggest Surfbort as opener and can offer a guarantee plus door split. We're flexible on dates in early 2027. Could you send over your availability and terms?

Thanks,
[Your name], Talent Buyer, Mercury Lounge
